newsitem.title: CHINA: China issues 4.0 billion yuan non-tradeable bonds.
newsitem.headline: China issues 4.0 billion yuan non-tradeable bonds.

text.p: China started to issue 4.0 billion yuan in non-tradeable bonds on September 3 to central and provincial government institutions, the China Securities newspaper said on Thursday.

The bonds have a five-year term, pay annual interest of 8.8 percent and the proceeds would be used for old-age pension insurance, unemployment insurance and other social insurance needs, the newspaper said.
The issue would close at the end of September, was not open to ordinary investors and would not be traded "for the time being", it added.
The scale of this kind of bond issue was much larger than in 1995, the paper said but gave no comparative figures.

The newspaper quoted an order from the Ministry of Finance as calling on finance departments and other government departments in all areas of the country to work closely together to guarantee the successful issue of the bonds.
